subject: Compact SDLC evidence snapshot for SIG review (code review, CI gating, secrets)
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@harboradvisors.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — brief SDLC evidence snapshot

Hi Sean,

We are preparing the SIG intake for Harbor Advisors and need a compact evidence bundle covering a few SDLC controls: code review process and samples, CI gating and approval trails, and secrets lifecycle (rotation, custody). The assessor is on a tight timeline and asked for a one-file index plus representative artifacts (no full dumps).

Can you provide an evidence snapshot that includes:
- A short index describing where each artifact lives (1 page)
- 2 sample PRs showing code review approvals and CI status
- CI gating playbook/excerpt showing automated gate criteria and rollback steps
- Secret rotation matrix (who/when/how, KMS/HSM notes)

We'd like that by Monday EOD Pacific if possible. If you need to escalate, let me know whom to loop from your side.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Senior Assessor, Harbor Advisors

[Attachment: harbor_sig_scope.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@harboradvisors.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — brief SDLC evidence snapshot

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the clear list — we can do a compact packet. Looping in Marissa (security & compliance ops) and Karthik (platform leads) to assemble artifacts.

High-level plan:
- We will produce a one-page index (PDF) that maps artifacts to control objectives.
- Provide two representative PRs (an internal backend change and a small infra PR) with reviewer approvals and CI pass logs redacted for secrets.
- CI gating excerpt and runbook steps (we'll include the gating job YAML + runbook excerpt).
- Secret rotation matrix CSV with rotation cadence and KMS key IDs (redact customer-specific keys).

Marissa / Karthik — target to deliver draft bundle for Olivia by Mon 11/22 EOD Pacific. If we need more time, we'll send an interim index tonight.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: none]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Artifact selection for Harbor SIG — please review

Team — quick coordination thread to pick final artifacts for the compact SIG packet. Please reply inline with 'approve' or 'swap' and suggested replacement. We need a publish-ready bundle Monday.

Proposed artifacts (draft):
1) sdlc_evidence_index.pdf — one-page index mapping controls to artifacts (draft attached).
2) code_review_sample_PRs.zip — includes: PR#4421_backend-auth-change.md (shows 2 approvers), PR#4478_infra-allowlist.md (ops reviewer + CI green). Redact any commit tokens.
3) ci_pipeline_runbook.md — gating criteria, automatic rollback triggers, required approvals for production deploys.
4) secret-rotation-matrix.csv — rotation frequency, steward, KMS alias (customer aliases redacted).

Risk notes: PRs contain small snippets of diffs; ensure no internal token values or developer machines' IPs are included. For CI logs, include only status snippets with timestamps, not full logs.

Marissa — can you confirm the KMS alias redaction policy and sign off on the matrix?
Karthik — please confirm the CI gating excerpt is sufficient for SIG (we should include the job name and the conditional checks).

Thanks — Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@harboradvisors.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: Compact SDLC evidence snapshot for Harbor Advisors (SIG)

Hi Olivia — delivering the compact evidence bundle for Harbor's SIG intake. Attached is an index and representative artifacts as requested. Summary below: 

Bundle contents (attached):
- sdlc_evidence_index.pdf — one-page map from control statement to artifact and where redacted originals are stored.
- code_review_sample_PRs.zip — PR#4421_backend-auth-change.md, PR#4512_infra-allowlist.md (both redacted for tokens).
- ci_pipeline_runbook.md — excerpt: gating job YAML, approval gates, rollback steps.
- secret-rotation-matrix.csv — rotation cadence + steward + KMS alias (customer aliases redacted).

Notes and clarifications:
- We redacted all API tokens, ephemeral runner IDs, and customer-specific keys. The index points to secure storage locations (internal Drive paths) if you need assessor-only access.
- CI logs included are status snippets (pass/fail + timestamp) only, per our evidence handling policy.
- Emergency key rotation process is summarized in the matrix and references our internal runbook (link included in the index).

If you'd like an expanded set (full CI logs or additional PRs), we can provide that via a secure transfer and NDA scope — just say the word.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: sdlc_evidence_index.pdf (PDF, 84KB), code_review_sample_PRs.zip (ZIP, 310KB), ci_pipeline_runbook.md (MD, 12KB), secret-rotation-matrix.csv (CSV, 4KB)]
